# Project Design Context

Latest composition correction: owner found multiple complete desks repetitive. Consolidate to one compact workbench/room with one hero object per route and bespoke desktop/portrait POV. Hamza supplies spatial/focus approach (monitor, pegboard cards, robot screen observed directly); Clarissa supplies warm editorial atmosphere. Four-desk runtime remains an unrefactored baseline. Do not add another complete desk per route; prove compact Home/Projects first.

Latest About/Experience scope, 24 October: owner authorized both corners. Reading desk with open notebook/lamp/books for About; documentation pegboard with original chip/code/community illustrations for Experience. Published identity/roles are HTML from JSON, no invented contribution/year. Four physical corners, one renderer, distinct direct route/portrait/overview cameras, 24 local fallback posters. New static props batched by material to retain old geometry budgets. Metadata-only 21st search returned Impact Experience and editorial lists; reused project Navigation/SplitText/HTML patterns, no paid retrieval or external source review. See QA-STORY-CORNERS.

Latest 3D/motion revision, 24 October: owner positively reviewed the overall direction and requested better 3D plus robot motion. Original articulated rig, tapered housings, bearings/collars/flange, linked cables and upright gripper. Calm 16s observational sweep; roughly 30Hz render cap only on visible/unpaused Projects. Pause/reduced motion freeze, hidden/other routes/static stop its loop. Home remains event-driven. Wood/metal, robotics keyboard and drawers refined. No new dependency or corner. See docs/QA-ROBOT-MOTION.md.

Previous robotics scope, 24 October: Projects now has a separate original robotics workbench within the same lab/renderer, with articulated arm/gripper, fixture and diagram monitor. Illustrative, not owner portfolio work. Inspect ASCII removed from active engine/UI. Hide Text automatically enables drag/arrow/reset including touch; Show Text/Escape restores reading pose/focus/scroll. Explicit Explore remains optional while reading. Event-driven GSAP camera/target/FOV/fog, 1.25s route/restore and 1.15s overview, no idle animation. Pause/reduced motion settle immediately. Four poses/12 local posters; each workspace has its own overview. Other corners remain future work. QA: docs/QA-ROBOTICS-BAY.md.

Latest owner revision, 24 October: a seated view at the workbench, facing the pegboard behind the HTML intro. Keyboard/cables in the foreground; no full-table display framing. Camera/portrait/posters updated; Home review precedes other corners. Text remains accessible HTML, not 3D mesh lettering or an orbit-tracked surface.

Current prop refinement: ANSI 60% keyboard with local legends, smooth coiled cable/connectors, instrument bezels/knobs/sockets, supported monitor, bound notebook, screwdriver handles and lamp geometry. World-unit bevels and texture aspect ratios replace distorted primitive scaling. Existing camera/content retained; no external assets/dependency added. See QA-HOME-LAB for verification and device-performance limits.
